gettingStartedHtml:
1. Install Unreal AngelScript from the Rider plugin Marketplace and restart Rider.
  2. Disable other plugins that register AngelScript .as files. Disable or uninstall the standalone Unreal AngelScript Clang-Format plugin if present.
  3. Open your Unreal project or its Script folder, then open an .as file.
  4. In Settings | Tools | AngelScript, select the Bundled language server. Install Node.js 22 or later and set its executable path if automatic detection fails.
  5. Run an Unreal Editor or game with AngelScript enabled. Match its debug address and port; the default is 127.0.0.1:27099.
  6. For debugging, create an AngelScript Run/Debug Configuration and launch it while Unreal is running. Configure formatting in Settings | Tools | AngelScript Clang-Format.
